response_format.funnel: Пул {raw} → окно {in_window} → повтор {previously_shown} → новых {new} → с динамикой {with_trend} → выбор {selected}.
match_lines: {country_ru}, {league_ru}, {category_ru}. {interval}: удары {shots}, створ {on_target}, опасные {dangerous}; всего: удары {total_shots}, xG {xg}. {scenario}, риск {risk}.
Справочно: ТБ{line} ×{over}; ещё {additional_goals} гола для полного выигрыша.

user_total_policy.integer_or_half: Keep the reference line and its quoted over price.
user_total_policy.quarter: Subtract 0.25 from the reference line; never reuse its price.
user_total_policy.rounded_price: Use a verified quote for that exact line, otherwise: коэффициент нужно проверить
user_total_policy.missing_reference: н/д; do not invent a line or use an outdated quote.
user_total_policy.selection_effect: None; presentation rule, not proof of profitability; no additional API calls.

response_format.footer:
Линии: {odds_time_msk} МСК, тотал по правилу пользователя. История - средние тоталы завершённых матчей. Реестр: {actual_registry_status}.
Уверенность: {confidence}/100 в данных снимка, не вероятность гола.
rules: Russian names; five consecutive lines per match; no tables or blank lines inside a match.
Use actual intervals and phase; preserve material uncertainty, partial xG and red cards compactly in the statistics/risk line.
No extra historical fields in default chat output; retain full source profiles and ranking.
Confidence is evidence-based, not a fixed template number.
No matches: header, funnel, Подходящих матчей нет, confidence. API failure: report failure, never invent an empty pool.
Do not wait for odds or registry before publishing the ready selection; use н/д and actual status.
